gate: D2FC2 independent NF-kB generator/modal and publication-native validation-observability test
scientific_question: Does an independent NF-kB model contain a licensed stable complex-conjugate local mode at its source-native unstimulated equilibrium, and is that modal frequency observable in the peer-reviewed publication's five held-out mean nuclear-RelA validation conditions?

external_source.paper: Smeal SW et al. Nature Communications 16, 7329 (2025). DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-62837-0.
external_source.partition_source: Peer-reviewed article Methods/Results: optimization used Control, 1x6min, 1x30min, 4x1.5min; five remaining mean conditions were validation not used for PSO.

generator_gate.equilibrium_protocol: Use source-native D2FC Squared model, source-native best parameter set, TR=0, and source-native 10-day equilibration.
generator_gate.jacobian: Finite-difference autonomous species dynamics at equilibrated TR=0 state with step multipliers 1, 0.5, 0.25; preserve full spectrum.
generator_gate.pair_rule: If exactly one numerically stable complex-conjugate pair is present, it is the candidate. If zero, refuse. If more than one and no pre-outcome biological selection rule exists, return NON_IDENTIFIABLE rather than switch pairs.
generator_gate.chi_rule: For the stable candidate pair, chi_bio = -Re(lambda)/abs(lambda). No chi=1 biological boundary is inferred.

empirical_validation_gate.observable: Mean nuclear RelA fold-change from all five publication-native held-out validation conditions.
empirical_validation_gate.identifiable_condition: At least two local maxima after preprocessing.
empirical_validation_gate.support_rule: At least 3 of 5 held-out conditions identifiable and median relative frequency error to the single predeclared generator pair <= 0.25.

falsifiers: More than one stable pair without a pre-outcome selection rule.
Numerical pair instability above frozen tolerance.
Fewer than 3 of 5 held-out conditions identify an oscillatory timescale.

known_bad_requirement.generator: Stable real diagonal Jacobian must refuse complex-pair scalar.
known_bad_requirement.empirical: Monotone traces must fail oscillatory identifiability.

claim_ceiling.pass: Independent external support for a bounded model-specific biological chi_bio mode class and Chi_bio modal representation across two NF-kB model lineages. No universal biological scalar or chi=1 boundary.
claim_ceiling.fail: Preserve failure; Jaruszewicz remains P0-Q model-specific qualification.
